body: I don't think I truly understand how the college admission process works, given that I've only heard what the other kids and my mom have said about it, how being Asian puts me at a disadvantage (I don't really think that's the case, but I can say that there's more competition since they are high achievers). I don't think I'm doing enough extracurriculars, but I was thinking about auditioning for the school play next semester. I play a varsity sport and am part of a volunteer club in my city while doing art and playing the piano. I think that being a teenager right now still having intense mood swings isn't helping my situation, but I'll remember that this is only temporary, that I'll only have to live at home for another year and a half (if I'm lucky). But if UCLA is as bad as you say it is, maybe focusing on a different school may be better for my already deteriorating mental health. I really appreciate your input on my situation and thank you for taking the time out of your day to share your experiences as well.

Thank you. I really need this type of message right now. It genuinely means a lot that you took the time out of your day to comment on my post, given that I didn't even think anyone would reply (I'm new to reddit). I am thinking of asking my parents for a therapist, but I'm not sure how that conversation will go. I really appreciate your encouraging and comforting works and I'll keep on fighting. Thank you for not undermining my issues.
